detail.investigation: 1 of 4 unmuted failures is new since the prior build (#3.0.2640, which also had 4 fails). The new failure — QuotaGroup 'change order flow: request, evaluation, block traffic, approve' — is a client/Feign socket timeout: feign.RetryableException / java.net.SocketTimeoutException on POST https://microservices-qa.dynata.com/NexusApi/v1/nexus/d365/changeOrderStatus, which bubbles up as a 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR from dk-project-crm-rest. That is a QA-environment timeout, not a code or test defect. Critically, the build's changes list is empty, so no commit or developer can be linked to this failure. The other three failures are pre-existing (not new): a Spock assertion in QuotaGroup change order flow (AudienceChangeStatus expected null), a read-timeout on audienceGroups clone (another infra timeout), and a PES notification test hitting 'Tally mode change is not allowed, total quota less than soft launch quota' (a soft-launch/tally data condition). Recommended action: re-run to confirm the QA timeout is transient; no code investigation warranted.
